definitions.explanation: The designated place where passengers board trains, buses, or taxis.

examples.japanese: ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The taxi stand is in front of the station.

examples.japanese: 5⟦{番|ばん}→〜番：09873_ban⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ます→出る：00513_deru⟧。

notes:
Combines ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place). A general term for any boarding area or platform for transportation.

TYPES:
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}: bus boarding area/bus stop
- ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}: taxi stand
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}: train platform
- ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}: boat/ferry boarding area
- ⟦{遊園地|ゆうえんち}→遊園地：03174_yuuenchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}: amusement park ride boarding area

NUMBERED PLATFORMS:
At train stations, platforms are numbered: 1⟦{番|ばん}→〜番：09873_ban⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}, 2⟦{番|ばん}→〜番：09873_ban⟧{乗|の}り{場|ば}, etc. Station announcements use this format.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧ (platform — specifically for trains, from English "platform")
- ⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧: bus stop (official/formal term)
- ⟦バス{停|てい}→バス停：05295_basutei⟧: bus stop (casual)

The 〜{場|ば} suffix appears in many location words: ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (sales floor), ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ (parking lot), ⟦{遊|あそ}び{場|ば}→遊び場：23051_asobiba⟧ (playground).
